d373fcdd49ee41c5643c.en: Ben has 12 + 7 = 19 stickers. Together they have 12 + 19 = 31 stickers.
d373fcdd49ee41c5643c.id: Ben punya 12 + 7 = 19 stiker. Bersama-sama mereka punya 12 + 19 = 31 stiker.

e168de79e976b474c506.en: Blue is 1 block and red is 3 blocks. That makes 4 blocks in all. 24 / 4 = 6, so there are 6 blue marbles.
e168de79e976b474c506.id: Biru 1 blok dan merah 3 blok. Semuanya jadi 4 blok. 24 / 4 = 6, jadi ada 6 kelereng biru.

bf2e03f4756ba1ec2fdc.en: Blue is 1 block and red is 3 blocks.

91450dcaf3fb7635bb5a.en: Take away the extra 6: 30 - 6 = 24. Share equally: 24 / 2 = 12 for Bela. Ani has 12 + 6 = 18 stickers.
91450dcaf3fb7635bb5a.id: Ambil dulu kelebihan 6: 30 - 6 = 24. Bagi sama rata: 24 / 2 = 12 untuk Bela. Ani punya 12 + 6 = 18 stiker.

081ccaea03860d5ca44e.en: Take away the extra 4 m: 20 - 4 = 16. Each piece would be 8 m. The longer piece is 8 + 4 = 12 m.
081ccaea03860d5ca44e.id: Ambil dulu kelebihan 4 m: 20 - 4 = 16. Setiap potong akan menjadi 8 m. Potongan yang lebih panjang adalah 8 + 4 = 12 m.

f1cf348bd4cfe4877e18.id: Potongan yang lebih panjang adalah 8 + 4 = 12 m.

eaeedd1df80d11283966.en: Tia has 1 block and Sam has 5 blocks. That is 6 blocks in all. 18 / 6 = 3, so Tia has 3 cards.
eaeedd1df80d11283966.id: Tia punya 1 blok dan Sam punya 5 blok. Semuanya ada 6 blok. 18 / 6 = 3, jadi Tia punya 3 kartu.

dda262f791e624479cd8.en: Tia has 1 block and Sam has 5 blocks.
dda262f791e624479cd8.id: Tia punya 1 blok dan Sam punya 5 blok.

403f6c407619640a70e4.en: Box B has 4 extra and box C has 6 extra, so 10 extra in all. 37 - 10 = 27. Share between 3 boxes: 27 / 3 = 9. Box A has 9 balls.
403f6c407619640a70e4.id: Kotak B punya kelebihan 4 dan kotak C punya kelebihan 6, jadi semua kelebihannya 10. 37 - 10 = 27. Bagi ke 3 kotak: 27 / 3 = 9. Kotak A berisi 9 bola.

50caf465575c681197a9.en: Box B has 4 extra and box C has 6 extra, so 10 extra in all.
50caf465575c681197a9.id: Kotak B punya kelebihan 4 dan kotak C punya kelebihan 6, jadi semua kelebihannya 10.

47f1156dc6a9a86f441c.en: The 15 pages left are the other half of the book. The whole book is 15 + 15 = 30 pages.
47f1156dc6a9a86f441c.id: 15 halaman yang tersisa adalah setengah bagian lainnya dari buku. Seluruh buku ada 15 + 15 = 30 halaman.

0b59463902904c903206.en: The 15 pages left are the other half of the book.
0b59463902904c903206.id: 15 halaman yang tersisa adalah setengah bagian lainnya dari buku.

f6b6865191ef3a37f75e.en: Take away the 4 extra girls: 28 - 4 = 24. Share equally: 24 / 2 = 12 boys. There are 16 girls.
f6b6865191ef3a37f75e.id: Ambil dulu 4 anak perempuan yang lebih: 28 - 4 = 24. Bagi sama rata: 24 / 2 = 12 anak laki-laki. Ada 16 anak perempuan.

6cfce7fc9f7b9d5d3370.id: Ambil dulu 4 anak perempuan yang lebih: 28 - 4 = 24.

68ae547bd4eaf249edf1.en: Tom had 3 blocks and Jo had 1 block. After the gift, 3 blocks - 8 = 1 block + 8. So 2 blocks = 16, which means 1 block = 8. Tom started with 3 × 8 = 24 cards.
68ae547bd4eaf249edf1.id: Tom punya 3 blok dan Jo punya 1 blok. Setelah kartu diberikan, 3 blok - 8 = 1 blok + 8. Jadi, 2 blok = 16, berarti 1 blok = 8. Awalnya Tom punya 3 × 8 = 24 kartu.

0835cab594bfbdb771f4.en: Tom had 3 blocks and Jo had 1 block.
0835cab594bfbdb771f4.id: Tom punya 3 blok dan Jo punya 1 blok.

69e576f04ba6cd69b026.en: Take away the 6: 30 - 6 = 24. Share equally: 24 / 2 = 12. The smaller number is 12 and the bigger is 18.
69e576f04ba6cd69b026.id: Ambil dulu 6: 30 - 6 = 24. Bagi sama rata: 24 / 2 = 12. Bilangan yang lebih kecil 12 dan yang lebih besar 18.

c7a6fc5757473d61ba18.en: The smaller number is 12 and the bigger is 18.
c7a6fc5757473d61ba18.id: Bilangan yang lebih kecil 12 dan yang lebih besar 18.

66c118bebaa0c8cc1ddb.en: Take away the 5 loose oranges: 29 - 5 = 24. Share between 3 bags: 24 / 3 = 8. Each bag holds 8 oranges.
66c118bebaa0c8cc1ddb.id: Ambil dulu 5 jeruk yang lepas: 29 - 5 = 24. Bagi ke 3 kantong: 24 / 3 = 8. Setiap kantong berisi 8 jeruk.

e175c81586e81e2f3e68.en: Bo has 1 block, Amy 2 blocks and Cy 2 blocks - 5. In all there are 5 blocks - 5 = 25. So 5 blocks = 30 and 1 block = 6. Bo has 6 stickers.
e175c81586e81e2f3e68.id: Bo punya 1 blok, Amy 2 blok, dan Cy 2 blok - 5. Semuanya ada 5 blok - 5 = 25. Jadi, 5 blok = 30 dan 1 blok = 6. Bo punya 6 stiker.

8dfa39904fd9700ab6f8.en: Bo has 1 block, Amy 2 blocks and Cy 2 blocks - 5.
8dfa39904fd9700ab6f8.id: Bo punya 1 blok, Amy 2 blok, dan Cy 2 blok - 5.

809cf7c1e16903be5fa3.en: The blue part is 1 block and the red part is 2 blocks. That is 3 blocks in all. 36 / 3 = 12 cm for the blue part. The red part is 2 × 12 = 24 cm.
809cf7c1e16903be5fa3.id: Bagian biru 1 blok dan bagian merah 2 blok. Semuanya ada 3 blok. 36 / 3 = 12 cm untuk bagian biru. Bagian merah 2 × 12 = 24 cm.

bf09c6fb531053672398.en: The blue part is 1 block and the red part is 2 blocks.
bf09c6fb531053672398.id: Bagian biru 1 blok dan bagian merah 2 blok.

fbe7706b1e7b7b130ae9.en: Take away the 5 extra cows: 29 - 5 = 24. Share equally: 24 / 2 = 12 hens. There are 12 + 5 = 17 cows.
fbe7706b1e7b7b130ae9.id: Kurangi dulu 5 sapi yang berlebih: 29 - 5 = 24. Bagi sama rata: 24 / 2 = 12 ayam. Ada 12 + 5 = 17 sapi.

253b4787ddd5ea654628.en: The top shelf has 28 - 18 = 10 more books. Each book that moves makes the gap 2 smaller. So 10 / 2 = 5 books must move.
253b4787ddd5ea654628.id: Rak atas punya 28 - 18 = 10 buku lebih banyak. Setiap buku yang pindah membuat selisihnya berkurang 2. Jadi, 10 / 2 = 5 buku harus dipindahkan.

e3ad04aa9a0d9ade3d01.en: The top shelf has 28 - 18 = 10 more books.
e3ad04aa9a0d9ade3d01.id: Rak atas punya 28 - 18 = 10 buku lebih banyak.

df71678416849d8c103c.en: Each book that moves makes the gap 2 smaller.
df71678416849d8c103c.id: Setiap buku yang pindah membuat selisihnya berkurang 2.

5be59f3ef2909d44ba6e.en: A is 11 cm longer than C. Take away the extra: 25 - 11 = 14. Share equally: C is 7 cm. Then B is 7 + 4 = 11 cm, and A is 18 cm.
5be59f3ef2909d44ba6e.id: A lebih panjang 11 cm daripada C. Kurangi kelebihannya: 25 - 11 = 14. Bagi sama rata: C panjangnya 7 cm. Lalu B panjangnya 7 + 4 = 11 cm, dan A panjangnya 18 cm.

eed29f63489cef694f62.en: A is 11 cm longer than C.
eed29f63489cef694f62.id: A lebih panjang 11 cm daripada C.

8a4e9e2d37ae10a0792e.id: Bagi sama rata: C panjangnya 7 cm.

589f0dbc1f0ff333885a.en: Then B is 7 + 4 = 11 cm, and A is 18 cm.
589f0dbc1f0ff333885a.id: Lalu B panjangnya 7 + 4 = 11 cm, dan A panjangnya 18 cm.

6729f5872b267c7be646.en: The tank is half full with 18 litres. The empty half also holds 18 litres. So 18 more litres fill the tank.
6729f5872b267c7be646.id: Tangki terisi setengah, yaitu 18 liter. Setengah yang kosong juga muat 18 liter. Jadi, 18 liter lagi akan memenuhi tangki.

eae6d0f34d0efe48e53d.en: The tank is half full with 18 litres.

11b13e54347fc534faf9.en: So 18 more litres fill the tank.
11b13e54347fc534faf9.id: Jadi, 18 liter lagi akan memenuhi tangki.

bead36659fa03d695063.en: 14 + 5 = 19 children. Then 19 - 8 = 11 children are in the park.
bead36659fa03d695063.id: 14 + 5 = 19 anak. Lalu 19 - 8 = 11 anak ada di taman.

1fa492df813ff2ba1a8b.en: Then 19 - 8 = 11 children are in the park.

f041f801490db5ccd287.en: 5 boxes hold 5 × 6 = 30 eggs. Mum uses 13, so 30 - 13 = 17 eggs are left.
f041f801490db5ccd287.id: 5 kotak berisi 5 × 6 = 30 telur. Ibu memakai 13, jadi 30 - 13 = 17 telur tersisa.

a6238a18978a03518d17.en: Mum uses 13, so 30 - 13 = 17 eggs are left.

05ec5715ee06657d3ad8.en: Ben gives away 36 - 8 = 28 sweets. Each friend gets 28 / 4 = 7 sweets.
05ec5715ee06657d3ad8.id: Ben memberikan 36 - 8 = 28 permen. Setiap teman mendapat 28 / 4 = 7 permen.

829799b02dd87ec5519f.en: The opposite of adding 7 is taking away 7. 15 - 7 = 8. Check: 8 + 7 = 15.
829799b02dd87ec5519f.id: Kebalikan dari menambah 7 adalah mengurangi 7. 15 - 7 = 8. Periksa: 8 + 7 = 15.

8c9db95bf03ad248a5f5.en: The opposite of adding 7 is taking away 7.

85b9568107bd330f0951.en: Undo take away 3 by adding 3: 11 + 3 = 14. Undo doubling by halving: 14 / 2 = 7. Check: 7 × 2 = 14 and 14 - 3 = 11.
85b9568107bd330f0951.id: Balikkan langkah dikurangi 3 dengan menambahkan 3: 11 + 3 = 14. Balikkan langkah dua kali lipat dengan membagi dua: 14 / 2 = 7. Periksa: 7 × 2 = 14 dan 14 - 3 = 11.

0177d1658c8dab82082b.id: Balikkan langkah dua kali lipat dengan membagi dua: 14 / 2 = 7.

5f2ca1a67432fe6159ea.en: Undo doubling by halving: 20 / 2 = 10. Undo take away 6 by adding 6: 10 + 6 = 16. Check: 16 - 6 = 10 and 10 × 2 = 20.
5f2ca1a67432fe6159ea.id: Balikkan langkah dua kali lipat dengan membagi dua: 20 / 2 = 10. Balikkan langkah dikurangi 6 dengan menambahkan 6: 10 + 6 = 16. Periksa: 16 - 6 = 10 dan 10 × 2 = 20.

20d479e695774a1e42e8.id: Balikkan langkah dua kali lipat dengan membagi dua: 20 / 2 = 10.

6db341db4628bd47ed14.en: Before Bo gave her 3 she had 12 - 3 = 9. Before she gave 5 to Ana she had 9 + 5 = 14 stickers.
6db341db4628bd47ed14.id: Sebelum Bo memberinya 3, Dewi punya 12 - 3 = 9. Sebelum memberikan 5 kepada Ana, Dewi punya 9 + 5 = 14 stiker.

81e5935a0c278d4ab533.en: Before Bo gave her 3 she had 12 - 3 = 9.

2a42466bc950204ed59e.en: Before she gave 5 to Ana she had 9 + 5 = 14 stickers.
2a42466bc950204ed59e.id: Sebelum memberikan 5 kepada Ana, Dewi punya 9 + 5 = 14 stiker.

a02d78fe970f3fb0d64a.en: Before buying the pen she had Rp2.000 + Rp1.000 = Rp3.000. That was half of her money. So she started with Rp3.000 × 2 = Rp6.000.
a02d78fe970f3fb0d64a.id: Sebelum membeli pena, Mia punya Rp2.000 + Rp1.000 = Rp3.000. Itu setengah dari uangnya. Jadi, uang Mia pada awalnya Rp3.000 × 2 = Rp6.000.

74347101622fe51841ae.en: Before buying the pen she had Rp2.000 + Rp1.000 = Rp3.000.
74347101622fe51841ae.id: Sebelum membeli pena, Mia punya Rp2.000 + Rp1.000 = Rp3.000.

a965d332b354d713deb1.en: That was half of her money.

c151a47a94fe389a2b42.en: So she started with Rp3.000 × 2 = Rp6.000.
c151a47a94fe389a2b42.id: Jadi, uang Mia pada awalnya Rp3.000 × 2 = Rp6.000.

8abaf0306f61694fec44.en: Before he ate 2 more there were 3 + 2 = 5 cookies. That was half of the cookies, so there were 5 × 2 = 10 at the start.
8abaf0306f61694fec44.id: Sebelum Sam makan 2 lagi, ada 3 + 2 = 5 kue. Itu setengah dari semua kue, jadi pada awalnya ada 5 × 2 = 10.

ffa300ad33a6e6a6857b.en: Before he ate 2 more there were 3 + 2 = 5 cookies.
ffa300ad33a6e6a6857b.id: Sebelum Sam makan 2 lagi, ada 3 + 2 = 5 kue.

5ef2adce466346182814.en: That was half of the cookies, so there were 5 × 2 = 10 at the start.
5ef2adce466346182814.id: Itu setengah dari semua kue, jadi pada awalnya ada 5 × 2 = 10.

6da445df871765ddca72.en: Before the 8 got on, there were 20 - 8 = 12. Before the 5 got off, there were 12 + 5 = 17 people.
6da445df871765ddca72.id: Sebelum 8 orang naik, ada 20 - 8 = 12. Sebelum 5 orang turun, ada 12 + 5 = 17 orang.

6b26800f5d50f3ddc9f8.en: Before the 8 got on, there were 20 - 8 = 12.

88241e05aac794b4e7b7.en: Before the 5 got off, there were 12 + 5 = 17 people.

4127e76bc74c0ae96f74.en: Undo take away 4: 17 + 4 = 21. Undo times 3: 21 / 3 = 7. Check: 7 × 3 = 21 and 21 - 4 = 17.
4127e76bc74c0ae96f74.id: Balikkan langkah dikurangi 4: 17 + 4 = 21. Balikkan langkah dikali 3: 21 / 3 = 7. Periksa: 7 × 3 = 21 dan 21 - 4 = 17.

6355aa9c84c4d1edcd8a.en: Doubling back for each of the 3 days: 5 × 2 = 10, then 20, then 40. The pond started with 40 litres.
6355aa9c84c4d1edcd8a.id: Hitung mundur selama 3 hari, setiap hari jadi dua kali lipat: 5 × 2 = 10, lalu 20, lalu 40. Kolam itu awalnya berisi 40 liter.

fe82be1192395bad5e2d.en: Doubling back for each of the 3 days: 5 × 2 = 10, then 20, then 40.
fe82be1192395bad5e2d.id: Hitung mundur selama 3 hari, setiap hari jadi dua kali lipat: 5 × 2 = 10, lalu 20, lalu 40.

893c75ba7a782d4a1ebf.en: In 5 years he will be 12, so now he is 12 - 5 = 7 years old.
893c75ba7a782d4a1ebf.id: 5 tahun lagi Raka berumur 12, jadi sekarang dia berumur 12 - 5 = 7 tahun.

3a27c748d2c874b3a995.en: Undo take away 4: 14 + 4 = 18. Undo doubling: 18 / 2 = 9. Undo add 3: 9 - 3 = 6. Check: 6 + 3 = 9, 9 × 2 = 18 and 18 - 4 = 14.
3a27c748d2c874b3a995.id: Balikkan langkah dikurangi 4: 14 + 4 = 18. Balikkan langkah dua kali lipat: 18 / 2 = 9. Balikkan langkah ditambah 3: 9 - 3 = 6. Periksa: 6 + 3 = 9, 9 × 2 = 18 dan 18 - 4 = 14.

74dc20fe070eb43a7b1c.en: The shop sold 50 - 9 = 41 apples in all. It sold 12 in the afternoon, so 41 - 12 = 29 in the morning.
74dc20fe070eb43a7b1c.id: Toko itu menjual 50 - 9 = 41 apel seluruhnya. Toko itu menjual 12 pada sore hari, jadi 41 - 12 = 29 pada pagi hari.

577852238942ff366204.en: The shop sold 50 - 9 = 41 apples in all.

9d758ad8e03b4791b255.en: It sold 12 in the afternoon, so 41 - 12 = 29 in the morning.

f8355560c7ffe27b825f.en: Before the second gift she had (2 + 1) x 2 = 6. Before the first gift she had (6 + 1) x 2 = 14. Check: 14 gives 7 + 1 = 8 and keeps 6. Then 6 gives 3 + 1 = 4 and keeps 2.
f8355560c7ffe27b825f.id: Sebelum pemberian kedua, Ana punya (2 + 1) x 2 = 6. Sebelum pemberian pertama, Ana punya (6 + 1) x 2 = 14. Periksa: dari 14, Ana memberikan 7 + 1 = 8 dan tersisa 6. Lalu dari 6, Ana memberikan 3 + 1 = 4 dan tersisa 2.

1aff35b497db24307e57.en: Before the second gift she had (2 + 1) x 2 = 6.
1aff35b497db24307e57.id: Sebelum pemberian kedua, Ana punya (2 + 1) x 2 = 6.

55542c825dee78330d17.en: Before the first gift she had (6 + 1) x 2 = 14.

da1a9e7a16abeae3a6c6.id: Periksa: dari 14, Ana memberikan 7 + 1 = 8 dan tersisa 6.

304555ad64564737ee3d.id: Lalu dari 6, Ana memberikan 3 + 1 = 4 dan tersisa 2.

c88809007e8665db10f3.en: The lessons and the break take 45 + 45 + 30 = 120 minutes, which is 2 hours. 2 hours before 12:15 is 10:15.
c88809007e8665db10f3.id: Pelajaran dan istirahat memakan waktu 45 + 45 + 30 = 120 menit, yaitu 2 jam. 2 jam sebelum 12:15 adalah 10:15.

e0e53360c97e3afd6511.en: The lessons and the break take 45 + 45 + 30 = 120 minutes, which is 2 hours.
e0e53360c97e3afd6511.id: Pelajaran dan istirahat memakan waktu 45 + 45 + 30 = 120 menit, yaitu 2 jam.

cf2d1975e8d8ff4c73f2.en: Undo take away 4: 30 + 4 = 34. Undo add 9: 34 - 9 = 25. Check: 25 + 9 = 34 and 34 - 4 = 30.
cf2d1975e8d8ff4c73f2.id: Balikkan langkah dikurangi 4: 30 + 4 = 34. Balikkan langkah ditambah 9: 34 - 9 = 25. Periksa: 25 + 9 = 34 dan 34 - 4 = 30.

f74aa1ad8a2cecbe6580.en: His sister is 7 + 3 = 10 years old now. In 4 years she will be 10 + 4 = 14.
f74aa1ad8a2cecbe6580.id: Kakak perempuan Ali sekarang berumur 7 + 3 = 10 tahun. 4 tahun lagi dia berumur 10 + 4 = 14.

e93dec829922f26a8d08.en: His sister is 7 + 3 = 10 years old now.
e93dec829922f26a8d08.id: Kakak perempuan Ali sekarang berumur 7 + 3 = 10 tahun.

289166023c4042d42a68.en: Mum is 4 × 8 = 32 now. Dina will be 12 in 4 years, so Mum will be 32 + 4 = 36.
289166023c4042d42a68.id: Ibu sekarang berumur 4 × 8 = 32. 4 tahun lagi Dina berumur 12, jadi Ibu akan berumur 32 + 4 = 36.

31ef3c5f35eb32be7040.en: Dina will be 12 in 4 years, so Mum will be 32 + 4 = 36.
31ef3c5f35eb32be7040.id: 4 tahun lagi Dina berumur 12, jadi Ibu akan berumur 32 + 4 = 36.

0cc8dc95b0e8d4fa0fa4.en: Rani is 10 - 6 = 4 now. Three years ago she was 4 - 3 = 1 year old.
0cc8dc95b0e8d4fa0fa4.id: Rani sekarang berumur 10 - 6 = 4. Tiga tahun lalu dia berumur 4 - 3 = 1 tahun.

832c6fff045d035dbcfc.en: Three years ago she was 4 - 3 = 1 year old.
832c6fff045d035dbcfc.id: Tiga tahun lalu dia berumur 4 - 3 = 1 tahun.

eb5da9db2d3f03ca720b.en: Take away the extra 30: 38 - 30 = 8. The son is 8 / 2 = 4. The father is 4 + 30 = 34.
eb5da9db2d3f03ca720b.id: Kurangi dulu kelebihan 30: 38 - 30 = 8. Umur anaknya 8 / 2 = 4. Umur ayahnya 4 + 30 = 34.

3258a521ed0f4c1050b4.en: Their ages add up to 14 now. Each year the total goes up by 2. They need 24 - 14 = 10 more, so it takes 10 / 2 = 5 years.
3258a521ed0f4c1050b4.id: Jumlah umur mereka sekarang 14. Setiap tahun jumlahnya bertambah 2. Masih perlu 24 - 14 = 10 lagi, jadi butuh waktu 10 / 2 = 5 tahun.

809c1582e3d1ae2b3d84.en: Their ages add up to 14 now.

d1fc5e1d3de1c74d8516.id: Masih perlu 24 - 14 = 10 lagi, jadi butuh waktu 10 / 2 = 5 tahun.

063a090e130299234eaf.en: Ani is 6 + 2 = 8. Ben is 8 + 3 = 11 years old.

f7fd0b3d3443a59da53b.en: The gap between their ages is always 4 years. When Mia is 10, her brother is 10 + 4 = 14.

ec155f6aff0865a018dc.en: The gap between their ages is always 4 years.

17f69b7f1038fc70ce1d.id: Saat Mia berumur 10, kakak laki-lakinya berumur 10 + 4 = 14.

d4ff6bebcd15aa05c1a7.en: The tens digit is 2 blocks and the ones digit is 1 block. 3 blocks make 9, so 1 block is 3. The tens digit is 6, and the number is 63.
d4ff6bebcd15aa05c1a7.id: Angka puluhan itu 2 balok dan angka satuan itu 1 balok. 3 balok sama dengan 9, jadi 1 balok sama dengan 3. Angka puluhannya 6, dan bilangannya 63.

da57d62599af639a913c.en: The tens digit is 2 blocks and the ones digit is 1 block.
da57d62599af639a913c.id: Angka puluhan itu 2 balok dan angka satuan itu 1 balok.

537598fea203e0cb75a8.id: 3 balok sama dengan 9, jadi 1 balok sama dengan 3.

aa5fe113e8f282f1e3ae.en: The tens digit is 6, and the number is 63.

e29eed8a4a203061e554.en: The middle number is 24 / 3 = 8. The numbers are 7, 8 and 9. The smallest number is 7.
e29eed8a4a203061e554.id: Bilangan yang di tengah adalah 24 / 3 = 8. Bilangannya adalah 7, 8, dan 9. Bilangan terkecilnya 7.

342e4054f9169038c2bc.en: Try 7, 8, 9, 10. They add up to 7 + 8 + 9 + 10 = 34. So the smallest number is 7.

08fd1350d7dc824271b0.en: The numbers are on each side of 12 and differ by 2, so they are 11 and 13. 11 + 13 = 24. The bigger number is 13.
08fd1350d7dc824271b0.id: Kedua bilangan itu ada di kiri dan kanan 12 dan selisihnya 2, jadi bilangannya 11 dan 13. 11 + 13 = 24. Bilangan yang lebih besar adalah 13.

513dab5f0f2109b16bd3.en: The numbers are on each side of 12 and differ by 2, so they are 11 and 13.
513dab5f0f2109b16bd3.id: Kedua bilangan itu ada di kiri dan kanan 12 dan selisihnya 2, jadi bilangannya 11 dan 13.

c740d92b5c731606a9fd.en: Doubling and adding 5 means number + number + 5. Adding 12 means number + 12. Take away the number from both: number + 5 = 12. So the number is 7. Check: 7 × 2 + 5 = 19 and 7 + 12 = 19.
c740d92b5c731606a9fd.id: Dua kali lipat lalu ditambah 5 berarti bilangan + bilangan + 5. Ditambah 12 berarti bilangan + 12. Kurangi keduanya dengan bilangan itu: bilangan + 5 = 12. Jadi, bilangannya 7. Periksa: 7 × 2 + 5 = 19 dan 7 + 12 = 19.

87510c95ea6f7470d0dd.en: Doubling and adding 5 means number + number + 5.
87510c95ea6f7470d0dd.id: Dua kali lipat lalu ditambah 5 berarti bilangan + bilangan + 5.

938cbe42bc76d2a55fef.en: Take away the number from both: number + 5 = 12.
938cbe42bc76d2a55fef.id: Kurangi keduanya dengan bilangan itu: bilangan + 5 = 12.

1418af6bd28b26a95cdd.en: Double 12 is 24. 24 - 17 = 7. So double 12 is 7 more than 17.
1418af6bd28b26a95cdd.id: Dua kali 12 adalah 24. 24 - 17 = 7. Jadi, dua kali 12 itu 7 lebih besar daripada 17.

b450309179fd9e872348.id: Jadi, dua kali 12 itu 7 lebih besar daripada 17.

fd321b0410e123e69b84.en: The number is 14 × 2 = 28. A quarter of 28 is 7. Also, a quarter is half of 14, which is 7.
fd321b0410e123e69b84.id: Bilangannya 14 × 2 = 28. Seperempat dari 28 adalah 7. Selain itu, seperempat adalah setengah dari 14, yaitu 7.

5a0b9fdee1858725afc7.en: Also, a quarter is half of 14, which is 7.
5a0b9fdee1858725afc7.id: Selain itu, seperempat adalah setengah dari 14, yaitu 7.

31686a2a2af0ac948af9.en: The pairs that multiply to 12 are 1 and 12, 2 and 6, and 3 and 4. Only 3 + 4 = 7. The bigger number is 4.
31686a2a2af0ac948af9.id: Pasangan yang hasil kalinya 12 adalah 1 dan 12, 2 dan 6, serta 3 dan 4. Hanya 3 + 4 = 7. Bilangan yang lebih besar adalah 4.

66e44dceee4d7f3c493e.en: The pairs that multiply to 12 are 1 and 12, 2 and 6, and 3 and 4.
66e44dceee4d7f3c493e.id: Pasangan yang hasil kalinya 12 adalah 1 dan 12, 2 dan 6, serta 3 dan 4.
